learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to use capital letters, full stops, question marks, and commas to make their writing clear and easy to read.]
warm_up_hook: 🚦 Imagine a road without any traffic lights! Cars would crash everywhere. Punctuation marks are the traffic lights of English grammar. They tell our sentences when to start, pause, and stop!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Always use a Capital Letter for three things: 1. The first letter of a sentence. 2. The word 'I' (no matter where it is). 3. Proper Nouns (special names of people, places, days, and months).

lesson_modules.module_title: 🛑 Full Stop and Question Mark (पूर्ण विराम और प्रश्न चिह्न)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Full Stop (.) comes at the end of a normal sentence that tells you something. A Question Mark (?) comes at the end of a sentence that ASKS you something (who, what, where, when, why, how).
A Comma (,) tells you to take a tiny breath or a short pause. We use commas when we have a list of three or more things in a sentence.
examples_or_templates: I need a pencil[,] an eraser[,] and a ruler.
We saw lions[,] tigers[,] and bears at the zoo.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which sentence has the correct punctuation?
❓ Where should the comma go in this sentence: 'I ate apples bananas and grapes.'
options: I ate, apples bananas and grapes.
I ate apples, bananas and grapes.
I ate apples bananas, and grapes.
I, ate apples bananas and grapes.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: I ate apples, bananas and grapes.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rewrite this sentence with correct capital letters: 'my brother ravi goes to mumbai.'
subjective_practice.hint: Check the beginning of the sentence, the special name of the brother, and the special name of the city.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add a full stop (.) or a question mark (?) at the end: 'What time is the cartoon on TV ____'
subjective_practice.hint: Is the sentence telling you something, or asking for an answer?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Put commas in the correct places: 'I have a red blue green and yellow shirt.'
subjective_practice.hint: Separate the colors with commas, but don't put one right before 'and'.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🔍 The Red Pen Editor
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write a short paragraph about your favorite food but don't use ANY punctuation or capital letters. Swap papers with your sibling or parent, give them a red pen, and see if they can fix your mistakes!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Start every sentence and special name with a Capital Letter.
⭐ Use a Full Stop (.) to end a telling sentence.
⭐ Use a Question Mark (?) to end an asking sentence.
⭐ Use a Comma (,) to separate things in a list.
